notes: Batch 1 selected the os-2026.09.23-010738 rootfs. Its base DTB and PocketCHIP overlay are byte-identical to the July candidate (hashes unchanged); the boot script now carries the overscan bootargs and loads the 6.12.107 release paths. Labels are the external fixups of the shipped PocketCHIP overlay; dtb_symbols are the labels observed in the selected DTB's __symbols__ section. The overlay is applied by U-Boot with fdt apply from the rootfs UBIFS path /lib/firmware/nextthingco/chip/early/x-chip-pocketchip.dtbo. Kernel panel/backlight/touch drivers are modules; display behaviour remains a hardware-validation item rather than a known failure. See docs/image-provenance.md.
